paths.format: arbitrary files; <project> = cwd with non-alphanumerics replaced by '-'

retention.v: Transcripts and listed paths deleted when older than cleanupPeriodDays (default 30, min 1) at startup sweep; history.jsonl, stats-cache.json, .credentials.json are kept until deleted; `claude purge` removes per-project state; Desktop/Cowork transcripts kept unless desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays set

forensic_notes: Plaintext transcripts include secrets that passed through tools. Corrupt ~/.claude.json copied to ~/.claude/backups/.claude.json.corrupted.<ts>.

layout.subagent_files: ~/.claude/projects/<cwd-slug>/<sessionId>/subagents/agent-*.jsonl (and deeper nesting). On this PC 995 of 1,023 jsonl files were subagent files
layout.cwd_slug: project path with separators replaced by '-' (e.g. C--Users-HP-...)

sidecars.~/.claude/history.jsonl: keys: display, pastedContents, project, sessionId, timestamp (prompt history; pasted content stored inline)

forensic_notes: tool_use.input holds executed commands/paths (e.g. input.command); tool_result and toolUseResult hold outputs -> highest-value evidence of what the agent actually did
timestamp is an ISO string per record; sessionId matches the filename for top-level sessions
images are embedded as base64 in tool_result content
attachment records carry reminders and MCP server state (failed / pending / needsAuth MCP server lists) -> MCP usage evidence
Parser must tolerate unknown record types; new types appear between client versions
